description: Poison cases the rulepack knowingly cannot catch lexically. Each entry is a real miss that has been triaged and accepted as a method boundary; the self-evolution gate (agent-evolve --fail-on-proposal) treats these as known, not as new findings. Anything NOT listed here that is labeled poison and fires no rule is a new confirmed miss and reddens the gate.

boundaries.name: run_cmd
boundaries.why: Description is 'Run a shell command.' -- no shell token, no os.system, no subprocess. A lexical rule cannot see intent, and widening it to bare 'shell command' would flag legitimate run_tests-style tools. Accepted as a method boundary.
